verdict.rationale: No evidence shows the Secretary of State's own filing forms or instructions can be downloaded without an account. The SOS site and the Ohio Business Central filing portal were never fetched past robots.txt (both returned 403). The only forms library cited is the Department of Taxation's tax forms library, which belongs to a different agency, covers tax documents rather than business filing forms, and says nothing about account-free access. The Gateway material describes OHID sign-in rather than open downloads.
